_comment: Trained correction network of the hollow correction layer. Kept next to the layer so that scripts/tools/build_hollow_correction.py works from a bare checkout; scripts/08_train_residual.py regenerates it from the input data. Inputs are the measured MDIS vectors of the step-6 pool; train and validation are separated by footprint.
arch: low-rank residual on measured MDIS inputs, spatial catalogue selection at inference
